test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. 212 in 2 years and to Rs. 224 in 4 years. The sum is:
solution:
Given 

Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212 

Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224 

Formula Used 

Amount = Principal + n(Simple Interest) (where n = no. of years) 

Calculation 

Let the Principal be P

Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212

⇒ P + 2(S.I) = Rs. 212 ---(1) 

Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224

⇒ P + 4(S.I) = Rs. 224 ---(2) 

Subtract (1) and (2)

⇒ S.I = Rs. 6 

Put the value of S.I in eq (1) 

⇒ P + 2(6) = Rs. 212

⇒ P = Rs. 200

∴ The required answer is Rs. 200
